meta.title: Request a consultation
meta.description: Ask about overseas trade fairs, buyer sourcing and matching, or export marketing. Our team will review your request and get back to you.

intro.title: Request a consultation
intro.lead: Tell us which market you want to reach and where you are now. Our team will review it and get back to you.

message.label: Your question
message.placeholder: Countries, trade fairs, products and timing help us give you a precise answer.

privacy.label: I agree to the collection and use of my personal information.
privacy.detail: We collect your company, name, phone and email only to reply to this request.

errors.invalid_email: Check the email address, for example name@company.com.
errors.consent_required: You need to agree to the use of your personal information to send this request.
errors.not_configured: Online requests are not available right now. Call or email us using the details below.
errors.delivery_failed: Your request could not be sent. Try again in a moment, or contact us using the details below.

success.title: Your request has been sent.
success.body: Our team will review it and contact you using the details you gave.

aside.title: Contact us directly
aside.note: We reply by phone or email after reviewing your request.
